prerequisites: Manufacturing methods (turning, milling, drilling... cutting tools, cutting parameters, tooling)

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to evaluate the design of a part with respect to its manufacturability and propose alternative, machinable geometries.
Students will also develop the ability to work in teams and engage in constructive discussion of their ideas.

syllabus_topics: Industrial case studies: Analysis of critical parts (aerospace, medical) where poor design choices led to increased production costs.
Hands-on workshops: Use of CATIA V5/3DEXPERIENCE to identify areas with low machinability
Hands-on workshops: Benchmarking of machining strategies (cutting parameters, tool paths)
PLM integration: Reverse engineering workflows using tools such as ENOVIA or Teamcenter
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
